summary: MotoDirect.nl B2C platform tested end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass covering catalog (list/filter/sort/detail), register (success/duplicate/invalid BSN/short pw/missing fields), login (success/wrong pw/unknown), /me + /my-orders auth-gated, admin endpoints role-gated. Frontend: landing hero + how-it-works + value props render, catalog shows 31 motorcycles with brand/price/sort filters, motor detail shows gallery + specs + reserve widget with correct 35% deposit (Dealerprijs €2.943 -> Aanbetaling €1.030), Reserveer nu without login stores intent + redirects to /motodirect/register, register/login store motodirect_token in localStorage, account page loads profile + orders, full Stripe checkout session created and user redirected to Stripe (deposit amount €1030.05 verified). Regression: dealer + admin logins still work.

minor.issue: Slow response (~10-15s) because send_admin_notification is awaited synchronously inside the request handler even though wrapped in try/except. If SMTP is slow the user waits. Consider firing notification as background task (asyncio.create_task or FastAPI BackgroundTasks).

action_items: Optional: make admin notification in /api/motodirect/register non-blocking (BackgroundTasks / asyncio.create_task) to improve UX. Current UX is functional but the submit button spins for 10-15s on slow SMTP.
critical_code_review_comments: motodirect.py stores BSN in plain text ('bsn': bsn_digits). BSN is sensitive PII in NL; consider hashing or encryption at rest, or at minimum ensuring the field is not returned in any endpoint (currently /motodirect/admin/customers explicitly excludes password but NOT bsn - admin can see plain BSN which may be intended; buyers cannot).
motodirect.py checkout error handler leaks internal exception detail to the client (f'Betaling kon niet worden gestart: {e}'). Prefer generic message + logger.error only.
motodirect.py reuses users.company_name / contact_person fields to store the full name; works but is confusing (a private buyer has no company). Consider a dedicated 'full_name' field.
MotoDirect frontend stores JWT in localStorage under 'motodirect_token' (XSS-vulnerable). Codebase-wide pattern, but a HttpOnly cookie would be safer.
Register endpoint slow due to synchronous admin notification (see minor issue).
